Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study compares three production methods for RBCEPs. EryEs (naturally released) serve as the baseline/control. NanoEs are produced via physical stimulus (sonication), and VI-EryEs are produced via chemical stimulus (calcium ionophore). The proteomics analysis used a one-way ANOVA with post-hoc Tukey tests for pairwise comparisons.
